Latin word

ūniversus

ūniversus, ūniversa, ūniversum

adjective

of all together, of the whole; whole, all together; as a whole

In this lexicon

  • general

    also used · classical · Cic. Off. 3.26: ūtilitās ūnīus cujusque et ūniversōrum; Liv. 22.32.2: ūniversa dīmicātiō, a general engagement (Lewis & Short)

  • whole

    also used · classical · Tac. Agr. 12.2: singulī pugnant, ūniversī vincuntur; Tac. Germ. 5.1: in ūniversum, “on the whole”
